candy.journal.kerem.title: Journal
candy.journal.kerem.author: Kerem
candy.journal.kerem.p1: Just arrived on this island. Quiet place, exactly what I was looking for.
candy.journal.kerem.p2: Second night. My sleep pattern is a bit off, the forest sounds different.
candy.journal.kerem.p3: Last night I thought I saw something. Maybe just fatigue.
candy.journal.kerem.p4: I'm no longer sure I'm alone. If I survive tonight I'm leaving.
candy.journal.elif.title: Note
candy.journal.elif.author: Elif
candy.journal.elif.p1: Decided to set up base here. Plenty of resources, no one around.
candy.journal.elif.p2: A week now. Sometimes I feel someone's behind me but no one's there when I turn.
candy.journal.elif.p3: Thinking of moving to the next island. Something's wrong here.
candy.journal.elif.p4: Why didn't I leave. Why did I stay.
candy.journal.ozan.title: Don't Read
candy.journal.ozan.author: Ozan
candy.journal.ozan.p1: 3 days in, no problems. Good start.
candy.journal.ozan.p2: Just heard a very strange sound. Maybe an animal.
candy.journal.ozan.p3: It wasn't an animal. I know it wasn't.
candy.journal.ozan.p4: This might be my last entry. If anyone finds this: don't come here.
candy.journal.zeynep.title: Notes
candy.journal.zeynep.author: Zeynep
candy.journal.zeynep.p1: Built a small cabin. Feels good having my own place.
candy.journal.zeynep.p2: This morning there was a footprint at the door. Thought it was a bear but not sure.
candy.journal.zeynep.p3: Didn't sleep tonight. Heard breathing behind the walls.
candy.journal.zeynep.p4: Morning came. I'm fine. I just need to sleep.
candy.journal.emre.title: Lost
candy.journal.emre.author: Emre
candy.journal.emre.p1: Lost my way. The map isn't working.
candy.journal.emre.p2: Seeing the same tree for the third time. Or so it seems.
candy.journal.emre.p4: The voices sound like mine. Like my own voice.
candy.journal.deniz.title: Diary
candy.journal.deniz.author: Deniz
candy.journal.deniz.p2: A week now, no one else. Maybe that's good.
candy.journal.deniz.p3: Last night while sleeping something held my hand. No one was there.
candy.journal.deniz.p4: I don't interrupt my sleep anymore on purpose. Staying awake is safer.
candy.journal.deniz.p5: third night. fourth. fifth. I'm counting.
candy.journal.mert.title: Something
candy.journal.mert.author: Mert
candy.journal.mert.p1: When I first got here everything was normal.
candy.journal.mert.p2: Then some things around me changed. The trees, or me?
candy.journal.mert.p3: When I looked in the mirror yesterday something was aware. It wasn't my gaze.
candy.journal.mert.p4: If I survive tonight I'm leaving tomorrow.
candy.journal.aylin.title: Last Note
candy.journal.aylin.author: Aylin
candy.journal.aylin.p1: Six months in this world. Never been alone.
candy.journal.aylin.p2: But for the last two weeks something is near me.
candy.journal.aylin.p3: Today we met face to face for the first time. But it had no face.
candy.journal.aylin.p4: This is my last note. I won't try to run.
candy.journal.aylin.p5: if you find me don't come here
candy.journal.sinan.title: Memories
candy.journal.sinan.author: Sinan
candy.journal.sinan.p1: My wife came with me. Now I remember her.
candy.journal.sinan.p2: But I don't remember when I last spoke with her.
candy.journal.sinan.p3: I looked in her room today. Empty. Maybe she was never there.
candy.journal.sinan.p4: Or she was always there but I wasn't.
candy.journal.yusuf.title: Sailor Yusuf
candy.journal.yusuf.author: Yusuf
candy.journal.yusuf.p1: My ship sank. Washed up on this island. Was grateful I survived.
candy.journal.yusuf.p2: Even the bottom of the sea wasn't this silent.
candy.journal.yusuf.p3: There's something. I felt it under the water. I feel it here too.
candy.journal.yusuf.p4: If only the ship hadn't. Oh if only.
candy.journal.nazan.title: Notes - Dr. Nazan
candy.journal.nazan.author: Dr. Nazan
candy.journal.nazan.p2: Case 4: patient claims to have seen themselves. Mirror rejection.
candy.journal.nazan.p3: Case 7: am I the patient? I hold the pen but who's writing?
candy.journal.nazan.p4: case closed. diagnosis: none. because I'm not.
candy.journal.cansu.title: Cansu age 9
candy.journal.cansu.author: Cansu
candy.journal.cansu.p2: mom didn't come today. dad isn't here either.
candy.journal.cansu.p3: the shadows are laughing at me
candy.journal.cansu.p4: I made a friend. it has no name but knows me.
candy.journal.cansu.p5: I want to sleep tonight but my eyes stay open
candy.journal.baba.title: Alone Father
candy.journal.baba.author: Hüseyin
candy.journal.baba.p1: Lost my son in the forest. Still searching.
candy.journal.baba.p2: I think I hear his voice. But when I run it fades.
candy.journal.baba.p3: Last night he sat in my room. I held him. It was just mist.
candy.journal.baba.p4: Maybe he didn't get lost. I did.
candy.journal.imam.title: Prayer
candy.journal.imam.author: Imam Bekir
candy.journal.imam.p1: Forty days on this land. I pray.
candy.journal.imam.p2: My prayers go unanswered. But something else answers.
candy.journal.imam.p3: Everything I believed shook today. But it isn't fear — it's clarity.
candy.journal.imam.p4: the creator is not here. what is here is what we created.
candy.journal.ressam.title: Palette
candy.journal.ressam.author: Filiz
candy.journal.ressam.p1: First days I painted landscapes. Every place as beautiful as the colors.
candy.journal.ressam.p2: Then portraits. Even though I saw no one.
candy.journal.ressam.p3: Today I saw all my portraits paint the same face. Mine.
candy.journal.avci.title: Hunter's Log
candy.journal.avci.author: Tarık
candy.journal.avci.p1: A good season. Plenty of game. Should be enough.
candy.journal.avci.p2: Yesterday I saw a track in the woods. Neither human nor animal.
candy.journal.avci.p3: I followed the track. It led back to my own foot.
candy.journal.avci.p4: I'm not the hunter. The hunter is following me.
candy.journal.yolcu.title: Traveler
candy.journal.yolcu.author: Nameless
candy.journal.yolcu.p1: Passed through everywhere. This is the last stop.
candy.journal.yolcu.p2: The other stops were like this too. Silent. Waiting.
candy.journal.yolcu.p3: Why do I always choose here. Why does it always find me.
candy.journal.yolcu.p4: maybe it's been following me along the road.
